question: How many three-digit positive integers $x$ satisfy $3874x+481\equiv 1205 \pmod{23}$?
solution:
Subtract 481 to get 3874x ≡ 724 (mod 23). Since 3874 = 23 × 168 + 10 and 724 = 23 × 31 + 11, this reduces to 10x ≡ 11 (mod 23). Now 10 × 8 = 80 ≡ 11 (mod 23), and 10 is coprime to 23, so x ≡ 8 (mod 23) is the unique solution class. Its first three-digit member is 100 = 23 × 4 + 8. Since 999 − 100 = 899 = 23 × 39 + 2, there are 39 further members, for a total of 40.
Final answer: 40
